ci.method: CI run 43701523023 on bf9d8ac, job sway (one of main's 19 required checks): a headless sway of the tests' own on ubuntu-24.04, with CHATMON_SWAY=1 making a missing piece a failure, ran tests/test_sway.py and tests/test_wayland.py: 49 passed, 3 skipped.
